rationale: The long-continuation thesis has weakened: after spiking to $284.96, price has faded on the last five 1m candles (284.69→283.73→282.78→282.64→281.61), now sitting below the 5m 9-EMA ($281.87) and essentially back at today's $281.30 open, erasing the morning rally. With SPY -0.58% and VIXY +1.68% as a risk-off headwind and a thin remaining loss budget ($241.64), locking the small $12.30 gain is preferable to holding a stalled position whose momentum structure has broken.
